seed_fields.description: Fit uncentered randomized right singular vectors of finite float64 CSR. Rank is a positive Python int less than both matrix dimensions; iterations and oversamples are positive Python ints; seed is in [0,2**32). Uses auto orientation and power normalization, a randomized range finder and gesdd. A dense basis lift uses unoptimized einsum. Returns owned float64 components (rank,features) and singular values (rank,), with right-vector sign choice. Copies CSR storage while retaining entry order and duplicates. Full input is not densified; reduced factors are dense and can approach input size for large rank/oversampling. Native pools are bounded to one. Caller owns total concurrency, feature ordering, training split and numerical scale. Finite input does not guarantee freedom from intermediate overflow; nonfinite factors reject. No text, label, vocabulary, centering or scaling policy.

seed_fields.description: Project finite float64 CSR rows through finite float64 components. Nonempty rows and at least one component are required; component feature width matches the sparse matrix. Preserves row order and returns an owned dense float64 matrix (rows,components). Copies sparse storage, preserving entry order and duplicates; inputs are unchanged. Rejects malformed sparse storage and nonfinite input/output. Native pools are limited to one. Caller supplies fitted components and feature ordering; no refit, labels, split checks, text policy or authentication of component provenance.
